rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb when something attracts someone's interest.

example.english: This documentary can fascinate many viewers.
example.traditional: 呢套紀錄片可以吸引好多觀眾。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2 ho2 ji5 kap1 jan5 hou2 do1 gun1 zung3

rows.note: Use this when someone is strongly captivated or enchanted by something.

example.english: That cat can fascinate everyone in the room.
example.traditional: 嗰隻貓一出場就迷住晒全場嘅人。
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 maau1 jat1 ceot1 coeng4 zau6 mai4 zyu6 saai3 cyun4 coeng4 ge3 jan4
